Deno
https://deno.land
https://deno.town
https://github.com/denoland/deno

https://github.com/architect/architect

Deno is a brand new experimental JavaScript runtime and deno.town is a web based REPL with linting and code completion to help you explore and learn the API.
Why Deno?

It is very fast
Built in least privilege security
Standard esmodules
TypeScript, JSX and TSX dialects supported

How

AWS Lambda (and friends) by way of OpenJS Architect
Deployed continuously with begin.com (Note! We have not officially released Deno support. Keep reading if you are interested in that.)

item.title: xpra multi-platform screen and application forwarding system
item.author: emecas
item.description:
xpra
https://xpra.org/
multi-platform screen and application forwarding system “screen for X11”
Xpra is an open-source multi-platform persistent remote display server and client for forwarding applications and desktop screens.

It gives you remote access to individual applications or full desktops.
On X11, it is also known as screen for X11: it allows you to run programs, usually on a remote host, direct their display to your local machine, and then to disconnect from these programs and reconnect from the same or another machine, without losing any state.
It can also be used to forward full desktops, from X11 servers, MS Windows, or Mac OS X.
